title: Manual Therapy Effect in Placebo-Controlled Trials: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

answer.design_quote: Randomized placebo-controlled clinical trials that used manual therapy as a sham treatment on subjects suffering from pain were included. Data were summarized qualitatively, and meta-analyses were conducted with R.
answer.k_quote: 53 articles were included in the qualitative analysis and 48 were included in the quantitative analyses.
